result:
I'd increase the average level of human intelligence and rationality by a significant margin.

Most of the world's biggest problems—poverty, conflict, environmental damage, bad governance, even personal misery—aren't primarily caused by a lack of resources or technology. They're caused by people being bad at thinking clearly, resisting their own biases, and cooperating at scale. Smarter, more rational humans would still have disagreements and make mistakes, but they'd solve problems faster, build better systems, and waste less time on self-destructive nonsense.

Everything else (curing diseases, exploring space, reducing suffering) becomes much more tractable once the underlying hardware improves. Giving people more raw cognitive horsepower and better tools for using it strikes me as the highest-leverage single change.
